📦 **ArtGallery `962b92e`** — art: add four named female ship specialists and character profiles

Create Liora the navigator, Vera the master gunner, Nadia the quartermaster,
and Maren the ship carpenter as independent full-body portraits in Astrid's
refined anime pixel-art style. Each portrait has an original character card
covering history, personality, duties, strengths, weaknesses, motivation,
recruitment story proposal, appearance and dialogue.

Preserve built-in image_gen white-background masters without modification;
record full prompts, reference and output SHA-256 values in each card.
Inspect all four portraits and verify complete heads, hands, boots and tools.
Gallery build/check pass: 1155 exhibits, four new portrait entries.
